name: AHV without work at 55 with CHF 2,000,000, Zurich
workings: AHV without work: base = net wealth 2,000,000 (the 3a account doesn't count) + 20 × 0.00 = 2,000,000.00; contribution 4,399.00 (3,604 + 159 per completed 50,000 above 1,750,000), + 5% admin costs = 4,618.95.
The year is a full AHV year: 12 months, credited with the minimum contribution's income 4,934.4828 in prepare (the wealth isn't known there).
